text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 • TURN; THE ART OF SAYING NO; I DON'T SKIP THE GYM
sees: A woman with a dark ponytail and gray hoodie looks sideways with a flat, slightly uneasy face, holding a small orange book in her outstretched hand. A big orange sign reads I DON'T SKIP THE GYM, with faded desk and monitor shapes behind.
message: The narrator is giving a firm personal rule, that she doesn't skip the gym, as a way to say no.
wouldConfuse: The orange book is unclear and has no obvious link to the gym text.

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 • CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; THE GUILT JUST EVAPORATES
sees: The same woman tilts her head with a worried frown and raised brows, in a room with a picture frame, a lamp and a couch. Large text says THE GUILT JUST EVAPORATES.
message: After saying no, the guilt you feel quickly disappears.
wouldConfuse: Her worried, frowning face contradicts the idea that the guilt is gone.

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 • CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; TRY TO BENCH PRESS 300 LBS
sees: A beige background with radiating sunburst rays and large text TRY TO BENCH PRESS 300 LBS. Only a tiny arm and hand are visible at the bottom left edge, mostly cropped out.
message: The narrator is giving an example of attempting something far too heavy, like a 300 lb bench press.
wouldConfuse: The figure is almost entirely off-screen, so the picture adds little beyond the text.

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 • CLOSE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; A BARISTA; MY SPOUSE
sees: An orange background with rays and dark translucent shapes. A horizontal line runs between two small dots labeled A BARISTA on the left and MY SPOUSE on the right, with a large circle marker near the right end.
message: Saying no is easy with a stranger like a barista but gets harder with someone close like a spouse.
wouldConfuse: The slider could be read as a scale of closeness or of difficulty, and its meaning isn't labeled.

text: INSIGHT 02 / 08 • SETUP; THE ART OF SAYING NO; THE GUY WITH THE PICKUP TRUCK
sees: Two characters stand side by side before faded city buildings. On the left is the ponytailed woman in a gray hoodie with a worried frown, holding an orange key at the bottom edge. On the right is a brown-haired man in a red shirt with a flat, neutral face.
message: The narrator is setting up a story about a man with a pickup truck who asks for a favor.
wouldConfuse: The key is barely visible, and the spiky shapes above the man's head look like horns.

text: INSIGHT 06 / 08 • CONSEQUENCE; THE ART OF SAYING NO; ABSOLVE YOURSELF AS THE CAUSE
sees: The woman in gray and the man in red stand side by side with flat, neutral faces, in front of sunburst rays, a picture frame and a lamp. The word CAUSE is highlighted in an orange box.
message: You should absolve yourself of being the cause of the other person's problem.
wouldConfuse: Nothing in the picture shows a cause or a problem, so the idea lives only in the text.

text: INSIGHT 02 / 08 • SETUP; THE ART OF SAYING NO; CONSCIOUS GENEROSITY
sees: The smiling woman in gray holds out an orange gift box toward the man in red, who looks neutral. The word GENEROSITY is highlighted, over a gray background with sunburst rays.
message: The narrator is describing giving freely and on purpose, as conscious generosity.
wouldConfuse: The man's blank face doesn't show whether he is receiving the gift.
